The committee met for the third time this year to review the proposal, and after a long discussion it decided to postpone the vote until the next session. Several members argued that the report had arrived too late for anyone to read it properly, and that voting on a document nobody had read would set a bad precedent.

Others pointed out that the delay would push the whole schedule back by at least two months, which would mean the work could not start before the spring. In the end the chair suggested a compromise: the vote would be held in two weeks, and the report would be circulated again with a summary attached.
